name: Financial Assistance for Professional/Technical Courses (HBOCWWB)
benefit:
Under this scheme, the full educational expenses of the children of registered workers in professional/technical courses are reimbursed by the Board in the following manner:
**Sl. No.****Professional/Technical Courses****Amount to be paid**1Degree/Diploma viz. Medicine, Engineering, Management, MCA, Law, Fashion Designing, etc. in all Government/Private Institutions/ Colleges/Universities etc.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant/worker should be engaged in building or construction work.
   1. The applicant/worker should be registered with the Haryana Building &amp; Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
   1. The registered worker should have a minimum of one year of regular membership.
   1. The worker should have an active membership with the Board.
   1. The children of registered workers who are pursuing regular technical/professional courses are eligible for benefits under this scheme.
   1. Financial assistance for education will be available for up to three children per worker.
